body: Correction to my 19:18 mail and to the 18:55 brief: do NOT run `make check-ci` or `cargo test --workspace` locally. The box is at load 19–29 on 6 cores, and full local runs are taking 45–80 min. Use the standard gate, `make check-ci-fast` + `make test-touched` (+ `make check-ci-compile` after merging main), then push and let CI run the full suite. If a full run is already in flight, it's your call whether to kill it and push now.
subject: Correction: do NOT run make check-ci locally
